verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents a built-in AI agent, Phoenix Intelligence, that you hand investigations to and that inspects traces, iterates prompts, and runs experiments. That is first-party natural-language operation of the product, but it rests on a single line in llms.txt. MCP endpoint access by external clients belongs to a separate story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the agent's natural-language command interface and scope of actions, coverage of other product areas (datasets, annotations, settings), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Hand investigations to Phoenix Intelligence, the built-in AI agent that inspects traces, iterates prompts, and runs experiments
